traderManager.name: Traders
traderManager.label: Manage Traders
traderManager.hint: Create Traders, stock them, set how they price and who they like, and post them to chat.

pricingPreset.name: Pricing
pricingPreset.hint: How hard Traders bargain. Charisma and the Trader's attitude move prices between the extremes of whichever curve you pick.
pricingPreset.fair: Fair — a stranger pays list price and sells at half
pricingPreset.standard: Standard — a stranger pays a 10% markup (recommended)
pricingPreset.harsh: Harsh — strangers are gouged; only real goodwill approaches fair

startingAttitude.name: Starting attitude
startingAttitude.hint: How a Trader feels about a character it has never met, on a scale of 0 to 100. Individual Traders can override this.

attitudeGainPerPoint.name: Copper spent per point of attitude
attitudeGainPerPoint.hint: How much a character must spend with a Trader to earn one point of goodwill. 10,000 copper is 100 gp. Set to 0 to switch the drift off.

attitudeGainCap.name: Attitude earned per visit
attitudeGainCap.hint: The most goodwill a single shopping trip can earn, however much is spent. A visit is one in-game day.

displayMode.name: Window style
displayMode.hint: Windowed opens a draggable, resizable window. Full screen covers the whole viewport, which suits shopping but hides the chat log behind it.

sceneButton.name: Toolbar button
sceneButton.hint: Show a shop button in the scene controls, so you can reach the Trader Manager without opening settings. GM only.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Write this module's diagnostics to the browser console. Useful when reporting a problem.

manager.title: Trader Manager
manager.duplicate: Duplicate this Trader, without its opinion of anyone
manager.emptyBody: Create a Trader to give it stock, a purse, and an opinion of your players.
manager.tabPending: Not built yet — arriving with a later milestone.

delete.title: Delete Trader
delete.body: Delete {name}, its stock and everything it remembers about your players? This cannot be undone.

identity.name: Name
identity.greetingPlaceholder: Come in, come in — mind the cauldron.
identity.greetingHint: Shown on the chat card and above the shop.
identity.startingAttitudeHint: How this Trader feels about a character it has not met. Leave at the world default unless this one is unusually warm or unusually mercenary.
identity.purseHint: What this Trader can pay out. Selling to it stops when the coin runs out.

stock.revealAtHint: Attitude a character needs before they can see this line at all. Leave blank to show it to everyone.
stock.previewNote: Prices shown for a Charisma 10 stranger at attitude 50 — this Trader buys at ×{buys} and sells at ×{sells}. Your players will see their own.
stock.dropHint: Drag items here from a compendium or the Items sidebar.
stock.dropNoTrader: Create a Trader first, then drop items onto it.
stock.dropNotPhysical: {name} is not physical gear, so a Trader cannot stock it.
stock.dropUnpriced: {name} has no price. Set a price override, or players will not see it.
stock.emptyBody: Drag items onto this window from a compendium or the Items sidebar to stock the shelves.
stock.clearBody: Remove all {count} lines from {name}? This cannot be undone.

generate.heading: Generate stock
generate.sourcesHint: Leave all unticked to draw from every compendium you can see.
generate.emptyBudget: Ask for at least one item first.
generate.shortfall: Not enough to go round: {detail} could not be found in the chosen compendiums.
generate.someFailed: {count} items could not be loaded and were skipped.
generate.noBrowser: This version of the D&D 5e system has no compendium browser to open.
generate.kindsHint: Tick nothing to draw from everything. Ticking a heading takes any of its kinds; tick the ones beneath it to be more specific.
generate.notStockable: {count} of those are not goods a shop can sell and were skipped ({names}).

trading.buysHint: Gear this Trader will not take still shows in a player's pack, greyed, with the reason on hover.

restock.due: Next refill in {days} day(s) of game time.
restock.hint: Refilling tops each line back up to its “restock to” figure. It never trims a line you have stocked higher.

trading.gainCustom: This Trader warms at its own rate
trading.gainWorld: Following the world: {cp} copper per point, up to {cap} a visit.

attitudes.note: Every player character in the world, with what this Trader would pay them and charge them right now.
attitudes.forgetHint: Clear this Trader's memory of them, back to its starting attitude.
attitudes.emptyBody: Create a player character and this Trader will have an opinion about them.

reject.notPhysical: This Trader deals in goods, not that.
reject.unpriced: Nobody can put a price on this.
reject.wrongType: This Trader does not deal in these.
reject.wrongRarity: This Trader has no interest in something like this.

error.notPositive: Every multiplier must be a number greater than zero.
error.buyNotMonotonic: A Trader that likes you must not charge you more. Buy multipliers have to fall from hostile through neutral to devoted.
error.sellNotMonotonic: A Trader that likes you must not pay you less. Sell multipliers have to rise from hostile through neutral to devoted.
error.arbitrage: At full goodwill the sell multiplier meets or beats the buy multiplier, so a character could buy an item and sell it straight back for a profit. The devoted buy multiplier must stay above the devoted sell multiplier.

shop.title: Trade
shop.rate: Buying at x{buy} · selling at x{sell}
shop.unstage: Take one back off the counter (or right-click the item)
shop.addCoinHint: From your purse, to balance an uneven swap. These exact coins change hands.
shop.counterEmpty: Click an item to put it on the counter; right-click to take it back.
shop.barterOver: You are offering {amount} more than they are asking.
shop.barterShort: You are {amount} short of what they will accept.
shop.settledWithGoodwill: Done. They think a little better of you (+{points}).

card.eyebrow: A trader is open for business

error.noGM: No GM is online, so the trader is away. Try again when one is.
error.queryFailed: The GM's client did not answer. Try again in a moment.
error.noTrader: That trader is no longer here.
error.noCharacter: That character could not be found.
error.noAssignedCharacter: You have no character assigned, so there is nobody to shop with. Ask your GM.
error.shopRefused: They will not trade with you right now.
error.stockGone: They do not have that any more.
error.itemGone: You are not carrying that any more.
error.nothingStaged: There is nothing on the counter.
error.barterRefused: They will not take that — you are {short} short of what they want.
error.tradeVetoed: They will not go through with it.
error.gmOnly: {call} can only be called by a GM.
